title: Python If Else Explained for Beginners (elif, and/or, Common Mistakes)
description:
Learn Python if, else and elif in about 5 minutes, with real code you can run. You'll build a grade checker, see why the ORDER of elif conditions matters, fix the two most common beginner errors (IndentationError and = vs ==), and combine conditions with and/or.

CHAPTERS
0:00 Intro
0:19 The idea
1:04 Indentation matters
1:31 elif: more than two choices
2:15 Comparing values
2:49 and / or: combining conditions
3:18 Putting it together
3:55 Try it
4:29 Recap

PRACTICE: write a program that stores an age and prints "Can vote" if it's 18 or more, otherwise "Not yet". The solution is at the end of the Try it chapter.

Watch next: Python Variables for Beginners: Why "5" + "2" Gives "52"

Code in Small Steps: one useful Python idea at a time, with real code you can run. New lesson every week.
The presenter is an illustrated character and the voice is synthetic; every program and every output shown is real (Python 3.13).
